neighbours.label: verb naming the intended action in a purpose or plan clause (aimed to identify and synthesise, run models, proceed with fixing)
fire: The engineers met on Monday and agreed to rebuild the pump before the season starts.
In this review we set out to evaluate every published trial on the drug.
Volunteers came forward hoping to restore the old chapel to its former state.
The council voted to proceed with demolishing the derelict warehouse.
Analysts went back to the archive in order to reconstruct the timeline of events.
Our goal this summer is to catalogue the beetles found in the valley.
She hired a consultant to streamline the way orders are processed.
The lab is now trying to replicate the effect in a larger sample.
quiet: The engineers met on Monday and the pump was already working before the season started.
In this review every published trial on the drug is listed in the appendix.
Volunteers say the old chapel has been standing on the hill since 1820.
The council meeting about the derelict warehouse lasted almost three hours.
Analysts in the archive found that the timeline of events was well known.
Every summer the beetles in the valley are larger than the year before.
She works as a consultant at a firm where orders are processed daily.
The lab is now a quiet place where a larger sample sits in the freezer.

notes: Card shows no single token; top examples are action verbs right after a goal/intention frame. Low confidence.
